name: Aikawa Riko
source:
A first-year student at the private school of Ondorigaoka. 

With her self-proclaimed large M cup size and a good appearance, she's popular among men. She's selfish and sometimes makes the boys at her school do her day shifts and cleaning on her behalf.

A first-year student at the private school of Ondorigaoka. 

With her self-proclaimed large M cup size and a good appearance, she's popular among men. She's selfish and sometimes makes the boys at her school do her day shifts and cleaning on her behalf.
